title: "10: Trees"

# Reading

- Interactive articles written by Amazon's Machine Learning team:
    - [Train, Test, and Validation Sets](https://mlu-explain.github.io/train-test-validation/)
    - [Precision & Recall](https://mlu-explain.github.io/precision-recall/)
    - [Decision Trees](https://mlu-explain.github.io/decision-tree/) but *stop before "Where to Partition"*
- Skim the [Getting Started](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/getting_started.html) page of the scikit-learn documentation.
- Read the **Intro**, **Classification**, and **Regression** sections of the sklearn User Guide page on [Decision Trees](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/tree.html). Also skim the **Tips on practical use**

Additional perspectival readings are on the Perusall assignment. Don't try to read all of them, just pick one or two.

Here's the [direct link to the NYTimes article](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/10/28/business/media/ai-muddies-israel-hamas-war-in-unexpected-way.html?unlocked_article_code=1.6Ew.lbql.j_QrAKlAbRBo&smid=url-share)

## Optional Activities

- Try the [Intro to ML](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/intro-to-machine-learning) lesson on Kaggle. You might even go on to try the [Intermediate ML](https://www.kaggle.com/learn/intermediate-machine-learning) lesson.
